race.comment: CRYPTION'S DESIRE (6) earns top billing after a close defeat here last time, even after being held up near the 300m. Strips fitter third-up and has placed at all three runs at this venue. Lerena sticking is another bonus. KING EMPEROR (3) is the obvious danger, having won his past two, most recently as favourite in a CL1 at the Sunny Coast after a slow beginning, and was a maiden winner over the track and trip the start prior. The wide gate is the only knock. ALL ABOUT ARTIE (2) is another last start winner and is the likely leader. Franklin knows him well and sticks. Will prove tough to reel in if left alone, though that doesn't look likely with KOBABILITY (8) engaged. She's chasing three straight after wins at Doomben and the Sunshine Coast. Will give a sight.
